fields.name: mintAuthority
docs: Optional authority used to mint new tokens. The mint authority may only
be provided during mint creation. If no mint authority is present
then the mint has a fixed supply and no further tokens may be minted.

fields.name: decimals
docs: Number of base 10 digits to the right of the decimal place.

fields.name: isInitialized
docs: Is `true` if this structure has been initialized.

fields.name: freezeAuthority
docs: Optional authority to freeze token accounts.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.newAdmin} accepts the nomination and becomes the admin of vault ${accounts.vaultState}

instructions.name: createShareTokenMetadata
docs: Create metadata for the share token
- `uri` - The URI for the token metadata

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin of the vault - only they can create/update metadata

accounts.name: vaultState
docs: The vault state PDA that owns the mint authority

accounts.name: depositMint
docs: The deposit mint used for PDA derivation

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} deposits ${data.amount} of ${accounts.depositMint} from ${accounts.senderTokenAccount} into vault ${accounts.vaultState}, for vault shares paid into ${accounts.senderShareAccount}

instructions.name: depositChecked
docs: As `deposit`, reverting when fewer than `min_shares_out` shares would be minted.
Added from the OtterSec-verified source (commit 87c0f2d4); the chain's IDL predates it.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} deposits ${data.amount} of ${accounts.depositMint} from ${accounts.senderTokenAccount} into vault ${accounts.vaultState}, for at least ${data.minSharesOut} vault shares paid into ${accounts.senderShareAccount}
${accounts.admin} nominates ${data.newAdmin} as the next admin of vault ${accounts.vaultState}, who becomes admin on accepting

instructions.name: operatorDeposit
docs: Operator deposit funds in the Vault
- `amount` - The amount of tokens to get in the Vault
The destination's registry entry (Subaccount PDA of this vault), which the deployed program reads after the listed accounts, and requires exactly when the vault has registered destinations.

instructions.name: operatorUpdateAum
docs: Update must be within a +/- 10% bounderies of current deployed AUM
Any update will increase / decrease the shares value

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.operator} reports that vault ${accounts.vaultState} has ${data.newAum} of ${accounts.depositMint} deployed outside it

instructions.name: operatorWithdraw
docs: Operator withdraw funds from the Vault
- `amount` - The amount of tokens to get out of the Vault
The destination's registry entry (Subaccount PDA of this vault), which the deployed program reads after the listed accounts, and requires exactly when the vault has registered destinations.

display.intent: Move vault funds to a strategy
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.operator} moves ${data.amount} of ${accounts.depositMint} out of vault ${accounts.vaultState} to ${accounts.operatorTokenAccount}, to deploy outside the vault
${accounts.admin} pauses vault ${accounts.vaultState}, stopping deposits and redemptions

instructions.name: redeem
docs: - `shares` - The amount of shares to burn

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} redeems ${data.shares} of vault ${accounts.vaultState}'s shares from ${accounts.senderShareAccount} for their part of its ${accounts.depositMint}, paid now into ${accounts.senderTokenAccount} less the withdrawal fee, which goes to ${accounts.feeRecipientAccount}

instructions.name: redeemChecked
docs: As `redeem`, reverting when the payout net of the withdrawal fee would be below `min_assets_out`.
Added from the OtterSec-verified source (commit 87c0f2d4); the chain's IDL predates it.

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.signer} redeems ${data.shares} of vault ${accounts.vaultState}'s shares from ${accounts.senderShareAccount} for at least ${data.minAssetsOut} of ${accounts.depositMint} after the withdrawal fee, paid now into ${accounts.senderTokenAccount}; the fee goes to ${accounts.feeRecipientAccount}

instructions.name: setAumLimits
docs: Admin Updates the AUM Change Limits

display.intent: Set a vault's AUM report limits
display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} lets each deployed-funds report of vault ${accounts.vaultState} raise the amount by at most ${data.increaseLimit} and lower it by at most ${data.decreaseLimit}
${accounts.admin} makes ${data.newFeeRecipient} the recipient of vault ${accounts.vaultState}'s withdrawal fees
${accounts.admin} makes ${data.newOperator} the operator of vault ${accounts.vaultState}, who moves its funds out to strategies and back

instructions.name: setWithdrawalFee
docs: Fee should discourage users from sandwiching operator_update_aum

display.interpolatedIntent: ${accounts.admin} sets the withdrawal fee of vault ${accounts.vaultState} to ${data.newFee}
${accounts.admin} unpauses vault ${accounts.vaultState}, allowing deposits and redemptions again

instructions.name: updateShareTokenMetadata
docs: Update metadata for the share token
- `name` - The new name of the token
- `symbol` - The new symbol of the token
- `uri` - The new URI for the token metadata

accounts.name: admin
docs: The admin of the vault - only they can update metadata

accounts.name: vaultState
docs: The vault state PDA that owns the mint authority and is the update authority

accounts.name: depositMint
docs: The deposit mint used for PDA derivation

errors.name: notOperator
docs: NotOperator: Signer must be the admin

errors.name: insufficientAmount
docs: InsufficientAmount: Insufficient amount for initial deposit

errors.name: aumLimitTooHigh
errors.message: AUM limit exceeds maximum allowed value
docs: AumLimitTooHigh: AUM limit exceeds maximum allowed value

errors.name: unauthorizedAdmin
docs: UnauthorizedAdmin: Unauthorized admin for metadata operation
